fields.description: Mirasol II adds 280 waterfront homes to North Harbour. Its stepped buildings include compact studios, terrace apartments, ground and mezzanine chalets, three-bedroom duplexes and upper-level penthouses.

research.community: Mirasol II, North Harbour, Raha Island
overview: The second phase has its own 280-home mix and Q3 2028 target, separate from the original Mirasol release.
research.locationNote: North Harbour on Raha Island, within Mina, Ras Al Khaimah. The portal’s Hayat Island grouping conflicts with the developer’s named island.
research.priceNote: The 25 September 2025 release and linked factsheet advertised studios from AED 861,000. This launch guide does not establish current availability.
research.paymentNote: The factsheet lists standard 50/50, special 35/65 and smart 65/35 options. The table uses the portal’s 50/50 aggregate reference; a dated developer instalment calendar was not verified.
research.handoverNote: The developer and factsheet forecast Q3 2028. Its 31 March 2026 investor snapshot reported completion as NIL; webpage progress panels are undated.
unresolved: Areas include outdoor space; duplex totals cover both levels once. Chalets are separate ground or mezzanine homes, not paired levels.
Current prices, title terms, service charges and original dated payment milestones remain unverified.
